subject.title: [Feature]: Persistent active-agent + workspace indicator in Dashboard (multi-agent safety)

question: Should this issue close after a focused active-agent plus workspace header indicator lands, or should closure require the broader switch feedback, live-target proof, and optional identity/switcher/prefix UX?
rationale: Current main lacks workspace header context, the focused closing PR is open and conflicting, and an open member draft proposes removing the breadcrumb surface, so automation cannot choose the final Dashboard header contract.

options.title: Land Focused Header Context
options.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95346 or an equivalent replacement for active-agent plus workspace visibility, then track optional UX ideas separately.

options.title: Broaden Before Closure
options.body: Require switch confirmation, deeper live-target proof, and optional identity/switcher/prefix behavior before this issue can close.

options.title: Replace Breadcrumb Surface
options.body: Choose the no-breadcrumb/topbar direction and define another persistent UI surface for multi-agent workspace certainty before closing this issue.

recommendation.title: Land Focused Header Context
recommendation.body: Land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95346 or an equivalent replacement for active-agent plus workspace visibility, then track optional UX ideas separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their open member draft changes the same header/breadcrumb product direction that determines whether the focused workspace breadcrumb should land or move elsewhere.
